concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-credit-card-update-node]] - Node.js stored-credit-card update by token, with the qualified PCI SAQ D advisory, conditional card-verification scope, callback example, and nonce-versus-raw-card recommendation and precedence
warnings: Preserve the source's word 'typically' and its recommendation language; do not present the page as a compliance guarantee or claim that every use of a credit-card method always requires SAQ D.
Keep card-verification scope conditional on verification being enabled, and do not reconstruct the unread linked verification rules.
Do not infer response fields or a success condition from the callback parameter names.
For mixed nonce and raw-card input, state precedence narrowly: individually supplied fields take precedence, while remaining attributes come from the nonce.
